child.text:
[{"insert":"Farmers Press

The farmers press is a strict overhead press performed one arm at a time, while your other hand holds a heavy weight low. That load held at your side forces your core to fight against tipping over, so you build shoulders and core strength at once. Press straight up and keep your ribs down. Follow it with the lean away lateral raise to finish the shoulders.
"}]
